bullets.bullet_text: Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing programs for regulated financial institutions, establishing traceable scenario architectures, challenger models, and model-risk remediation frameworks that underpinned enterprise governance and audit readiness.

Led quantitative derivatives and variable-annuity hedging engagements for insurance capital programs, applying exotic options pricing, liability Greek analytics, and higher-order stress testing to strengthen actuarial and capital-adequacy decision support (FSA-credentialed).

Architected enterprise risk-management operating models aligned to BCBS 239 principles, codifying three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk-data aggregation controls across regulated portfolios.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, stress testing, and model-validation work by structuring traceable scenarios, challenger variants, model-risk remediation, and governance evidence for regulated financial institutions.
Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital work using exotic pricing, liability Greeks, higher-order stress testing, and hedge design.
Architected ERM operating models and BCBS 239-aligned risk-data aggregation by defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics.
